styleBlocks.css: .report-builder-modal .report-builder-label { font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }
.report-detail-card small { display: block; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 4px; }
.report-options-details > summary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 4px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
.report-note-review { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 13px; }
.report-builder-modal :is(button, input, select, textarea, summary):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
#tour-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 500; pointer-events: auto; }
#tour-tooltip p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tour-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.tour-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--border); transition: background 0.2s; }
.tour-btn { padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; transition: all 0.15s; }
.tour-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border); }

empty.title: Welcome to getbased
empty.text: This quick tour is for a fresh profile. After the tour, guided chat will help you decide what to add first.

empty.title: Start Guided Chat
empty.text: Chat is the main path for new profiles. It asks for context only when useful and routes you to import or setup when needed.

app.title: Welcome to getbased
app.text: Health intelligence that's actually yours — five lenses on your biology, one private dashboard. Let's take a quick look around.

app.title: Import Health Data
app.text: Import lab PDFs, report photos, DNA raw data, or getbased JSON. You can also drop files directly onto the page.

app.title: Profiles & Demo Data
app.text: Switch profiles, manage clients, or load demo data from here. Each profile keeps its own data, settings, and tour progress.

app.title: Five Lenses
app.text: Move between Dashboard, Labs, Genome, Body, Light, Insight, and Tips. Desktop uses the sidebar; smaller screens use tabs and the menu.

app.title: Dashboard Overview
app.text: The dashboard summarizes the current profile. After import, widgets surface focus areas, priorities, general-information tips, body data, and light context.

app.title: Customize Widgets
app.text: Use Customize and Add widget to choose the sections that matter for this profile.

app.title: Display Tweaks
app.text: Adjust theme, accent color, density, and motion effects without leaving the current screen.

app.title: Settings & Connections
app.text: Configure demographics, privacy, AI providers, wearables, sync, and data controls here.

app.title: Ask AI
app.text: Use chat for guided interpretation, import setup, and follow-up questions. It uses the current profile context when an AI provider is connected.

cycle.title: Cycle-Aware Lab Interpretation
cycle.text: getbased tracks your menstrual cycle so AI can interpret hormones, iron, and inflammation in the right context. Here’s what’s available.

cycle.title: Your Cycle at a Glance
cycle.text: Cycle length, regularity, flow, and contraceptive info — auto-calculated from your period log when possible.

cycle.title: Optimal Blood Draw Timing
cycle.text: Get recommendations for when to schedule blood work — early follicular phase (days 3–5) gives the most stable baseline.

cycle.title: Phase Labels on Lab Dates
cycle.text: Each lab date is tagged with its cycle phase so you can see how timing may have affected your results.

cycle.title: Period Log & Symptoms
cycle.text: Log each period with flow, symptoms, and notes. More entries = better auto-calculated stats and smarter alerts.

cycle.title: Smart Alerts
cycle.text: Perimenopause pattern detection and heavy-flow iron alerts — cross-referencing your cycle with your lab results.

cycle.title: Phase Bands on Charts
cycle.text: Toggle cycle phase bands in the Layers dropdown to see menstrual, follicular, ovulatory, and luteal shading on your charts.

cycle.title: AI Knows Your Cycle
cycle.text: The AI chat factors in your cycle phase when interpreting every marker — ask it about any result for phase-aware insights.
